description: Transit Total Monthly Ridership is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (datahub.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. Total monthly transit ridership data. Includes counts for SamTrans bus, paratransit, CalTrain, Shuttles, and the BART extension without the Daly City stop. This data is from 2011 to the present. Shuttle data for July, 2015 is an average of July data from 2011 through 2017. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are transit, bus, train, public transportation. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: SamTrans. The portal shows 2025-04-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-smcgov-org-portal.
